scripts.dev:full: docker compose --profile db --profile storage --profile email up --build
scripts.dev:down: docker compose --profile db --profile storage --profile email down
scripts.build:prod: docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile --target production -t fullstack-api:prod . && docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile --target production -t fullstack-web:prod .
scripts.lint: pnpm -C apps/web lint && python -m ruff check apps/api
scripts.lint:ci: pnpm -C apps/web lint && python -m ruff check apps/api && python -m ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.test: pnpm -C apps/web test && python -m pytest -q -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api
scripts.test:full: echo '> Web unit' && pnpm -C apps/web test && echo '> Web e2e' && pnpm -C apps/web e2e && echo '> API' && python -m pytest -q -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api
scripts.test:ci: pnpm lint:ci && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:full
